title: Āsavakkhayo
text: 2. Jānato ham bhikkhave passato āsavānam khayaṃ vadāmi no ajānato apassato || Kiñca bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 3. Idaṃ dukkhan ti bhikkhave jānato passato āsavānaṃ khāyo hoti || Ayam dukkhasamudayo ti || pe || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti jānato passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 4. Evam kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la [pe] || ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti..
